body_markdown:
For years, cross-channel marketing hubs have helped marketers turn customer data into coordinated engagement across email, mobile, web, paid media, and other touchpoints. Forrester defines cross-channel marketing hubs as *enterprise marketing technology that supports customer data management, analytics, segmentation, and workflow tools for designing, executing, and measuring marketing engagement across digital and offline channels* .


Now AI is changing what these platforms can do and what marketers should expect from them. AI impacts every aspect of cross-channel marketing hub (CCMH) functionality. AI agents can analyze audiences, generate content, orchestrate journeys, and optimize customer interactions with far less manual effort. At the same time, third-party AI interfaces are changing how marketers interact with martech, and increasingly, consumer-facing agents are beginning to mediate how customers discover, evaluate, and respond to brands.


The[AI opportunity](https://www.forrester.com/blogs/predictions-2027-cmos-reckon-with-an-ai-reality-check/) here is significant; so is the risk.[The Forrester Wave™: Cross-Channel Marketing Hubs, Q4 2026](https://www.forrester.com/report/the-forrester-wave-tm-cross-channel-marketing-hubs-q4-2026/RES204371) helps B2C marketing executives navigate these market changes to make the right CCMH investment decision.


#### **More Marketing Doesn’t Always Produce Better CX Or Business Results**


AI can help marketers compress campaign development cycles, increase content production, and scale personalization efforts. But it can also help marketers produce more irrelevant promotions, increase contact frequency out of sync with customer preferences, or optimize conversions that don’t translate into profitable customer relationships. Marketers must[look beyond potential productivity boosts](https://www.forrester.com/blogs/good-luck-have-fun-dont-die/) and explore opportunities where AI can improve customer engagement. Marketers evaluating CCMH providers should ask the following questions:


- **Will the CCMH transform customer engagement for better outcomes?** Campaign velocity, content volume, and lower production costs tell you how efficiently marketing operates, but they don’t tell you whether it’s working. Look for evidence that your CCMH can use AI to improve customer outcomes and drive sustainable business value.
- **Can the CCMH work within an increasingly agentic ecosystem?** Embedded AI features are only part of the equation. Marketers must consider how readily their CCMH can work with external models, agents, applications, and interfaces. Make interoperability, governance, and control key selection criteria.
- **How well does the CCMH fit my operating model?** Large platform providers bring extensive ecosystems, global resources, and enterprise integrations. Smaller specialists offer greater flexibility, closer access to product teams, and more collaborative relationships. Match your CCMH solution to your implementation requirements, AI ambitions, and adoption readiness.


#### **Use The Latest Forrester Wave As A Starting Point For CCMH Selection**


[The Forrester Wave™: Cross-Channel Marketing Hubs, Q4 2026](https://www.forrester.com/report/the-forrester-wave-tm-cross-channel-marketing-hubs-q4-2026/RES204371) evaluates 12 of the most significant CCMH providers. We researched, analyzed, and scored their current offerings and strategies. We also incorporated reference customer feedback to help buyers understand differences and identify the right provider.


The differences go well beyond which provider has the longest list of AI features. CCMH providers come with different histories, architectures, areas of expertise, and visions for where customer engagement is heading. Some offer CCMH within enterprise martech portfolios, while others differentiate through marketer usability, commerce expertise, mobile engagement, or specialized services.


**There is no universally best CCMH.** That’s why we encourage clients to use the the Forrester Wave as a starting point and adapt the evaluation to their own priorities. For a broader view of the market,[The Cross-Channel Marketing Hubs Landscape, Q2 2026](https://www.forrester.com/report/the-cross-channel-marketing-hubs-landscape-q2-2026/RES195991) profiles 28 CCMH vendors.
